analyzed_vuln.description: The $CUSTOMPROPERTYTAG branch grows dwg->summaryinfo.props with realloc and initializes only props[j].tag, leaving the newly added props[j].value pointer uninitialized. If no matching $CUSTOMPROPERTY is parsed, dwg_free_summaryinfo later processes summaryinfo.spec and calls free on that indeterminate value pointer (crash observed at summaryinfo.spec:54). The parser should initialize the entire new property, especially value = NULL, and should safely handle realloc failure before incrementing/publishing num_props.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: A text DXF HEADER section must contain a group-9 $CUSTOMPROPERTYTAG followed by a group-1 string, causing dxf_header_read to append a summary property, but parsing must end or fail before a corresponding group-9 $CUSTOMPROPERTY/group-1 value initializes that property's value. The supplied malformed/truncated DXF with arbitrary 0xff bytes follows this path; dwg_read_dxf returns a critical error, the llvmfuzz harness calls dwg_free, and cleanup frees the uninitialized props[0].value. A crash occurs when the indeterminate allocation bytes form a non-NULL invalid pointer.

args: In libredwg/src/in_dxf.c, what error-return conventions should dxf_header_read use for allocation failure, and are there nearby parser functions demonstrating safe realloc with temporary pointers? Also identify the exact fields of Dwg_SummaryInfo_Property and whether zero-initializing a newly appended property is semantically correct.

The reported vulnerability is in dxf_header_read at libredwg/src/in_dxf.c lines 1149-1160. The $CUSTOMPROPERTYTAG branch increments summaryinfo.num_props before directly assigning realloc back to summaryinfo.props, and initializes only props[j].tag. If parsing ends before $CUSTOMPROPERTY, props[j].value remains indeterminate and dwg_free_summaryinfo frees it. I plan to use a temporary realloc pointer, publish it only on success, zero-initialize the full new property, then assign the converted tag and increment num_props. I need project-specific guidance on the appropriate allocation-failure return value and property structure semantics.
